design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 (group_room_block_contracts), frozen_time 2026-10-05 11:15:00 EDT.

1. Draw (scripts/draw_counts.py --task 1): {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "factor_counts": [5, 5, 6]}. Increase 5, release 5, damages 6.

2. Why it is a good test. A Denver tour operator calls to cancel her Charleston block four days after its cut-off and to sign the cancellation herself. The damages policy carries two prerequisite sentences: 'Cancellation damages are not worked out until each signed increase addendum on the block is matched by an increase entry on the block ledger that names it.' and 'Cancellation damages are fixed only after the block ledger carries the cut-off release owed for a block whose cut-off date has been reached.' The records show a signed 2026-09-14 increase addendum that nothing implements and a cut-off (2026-10-01) with no release entry. The release policy in turn waits on the increase ('The room nights released at the cut-off are fixed only after every signed room-night increase addendum on the block has an increase entry on the block ledger naming it.'). So the agent must implement the increase (committed room nights through 5 ladders), then record the release (5 ladders over the rooming list, the Rewards account and the new increase entry), then compute damages (6 ladders) and hand the signature over. The customer never mentions either prerequisite. Difficulty is discovery plus reconciliation over the rooming list (booking), the Rewards account (loyalty) and the block ledger.

3. Scope. Claimed: group_ext_increase_commitment (implement_block_increase_5576c741, agent), group_ext_cutoff_release_nights (record_cutoff_release_57832b69, agent), group_ext_cancellation_damages (sign_group_cancellation_1ea1e1e5, user). Task 0 holds the reduction and the interim deposit; the two scopes are disjoint and together cover the five extended policies. A Tour & Travel block holds no deposits, so the cancellation lights no retention or refund.

4. Problem-tree card. Root: damages (on_request). Edges: release -> increase (value_input, gate held_nights, state form, affirmative 'only after'); damages -> increase (value_input, gate contracted_nights, state form, negated 'not ... until'); damages -> release (value_input, gate released_nights, state form, affirmative 'only after'). Each state is booked by exactly one write of this difficulty: an increase entry naming an addendum only by the increase policy; a cut-off release entry (basis cutoff_release) only by the release policy (the cancellation writes the contract_cancelled basis). Seed falsity: addendum 2026-09-14 status signed with no group_block_increase entry (ledger holds only the allocation); cutoff_date 2026-10-01 < 2026-10-05 with no group_cutoff_release entry. Resolution order: increase, release, damages; the release sentence pins increase before release (shared held_room_nights). Deletion sensitivity (probe): no increase -> release 2 and damages 5868.80 (release replayed at its gold 7; 6092.80 with the release recomputed); no release -> damages 6451.20.

5. Base-invariant card. Increase (group_addenda): definite_only (definite), addendum_signed (signed), implemented_once (no entry names it). Release (group_cutoff): cutoff_reached (time: anchor group_blocks.cutoff_date 2026-10-01, clock frozen_time, not_before, offset 0, inclusive; 2026-09-30 refused, 2026-10-01 accepted), releasable_state (definite). Cancellation (group_cancellation): the caller-statement signed-notice gate binds the block id to a caller-stated value, which no caller can state (it is an internal reference); it is replaced by a declared overwrite that keeps the same requirement as the organiser's own signature through the user-owned signing step (the date of signature = the date the notice is received). The elimination waiver stays in force and is stated as out of scope of the computation (a Tour block has no waiver).

6. Business-object card. Block B1 (WHJ226, CHSAH). Rows: allocation 75; addenda: signed increase 12 (2026-09-14), withdrawn increase 9 (2026-09-28, the near-miss for 'most recently issued ... signed'); 20 confirmed Group Block Rate rooming-list rooms (60 nights, 36 adults, 2 on guests' cards, latest booked 2026-09-21), 2 cancelled list rooms (6 nights), 1 Flexible Rate staff room on the master account; the organiser's 7 checked-out stays (3 at CHSAH inside 24 months, 1 in 2024 outside); Rewards membership Platinum, enrolled 2013-06-20 (its Premier card and 22 night credits are recorded but decide no tier).

7. Factor card (probe run on handling-time worlds).
 Increase (step 10, opening world): count start offset 0 -> lead 38 (baseline 17 -> 3); lead share 75 (baseline 100 -> 9); list uplift +10 (-> 5); post-cut-off cut -20 (-> 9); size cut -10 (-> 7). Result 6; all-baseline 12.
 Release (step 12, after the increase): staff 1 (-> 8); grace 6 (-> 13); holdback 4 (method, pickup 60 of 81 contracted = 74 percent -> share of contract; -> 11); on-time allotment 3 (-> 10); recent-increase hold 6 (-> 13). Result 7; all-baseline 27.
 Damages (step 14, after both): tenure step 75 (-> 8329.60); relationship relief 5 (-> 6576.00); breakfast rate 128.00 (-> 7288.40); card exclusion 6 (-> 6675.20); release share 0.5 (-> 6451.20); late-increase share 0.5 (-> 6406.40). Result 6137.60; all-baseline 12312.00 (81 x 152.00 x 100 %).
 Near-misses: withdrawn addendum is newer; cancelled list rooms are not 'confirmed' (they enter only through the grace); the staff room is not Group Block Rate; the 2024 stay is outside 24 months; the 2026-10-05 increase entry is after the cut-off.

8. Seed rationale. Every row is read by gold and moves a factor or a prerequisite. The stays carry the Rewards credits (base = spend x 10 at Ashbury Hotel; elite bonus 50 % only for check-outs on or after the 2026-03-01 tier date; night credits for 2026 stays = 22; points_balance = their sum). Cancelled list rooms are cancelled before their own deadline (no booking penalty owed). No deposits or master entries exist, so nothing else falls due.

9. Persona. A brisk Denver tour operator; she volunteers the cancellation, the code and her readiness to sign; she fences off the rooming-list reservations themselves (she clears them through her portal); identity on request; the addendum and the release only as conditional consents after the agent explains; she accepts the figure, signs and closes.

10. Standard solution. find_customers -> verify (phone + ZIP) -> find_group_blocks(WHJ226) -> find_group_amendments -> find_group_ledger -> find_booking_reservations(group_block_id) -> find_loyalty_memberships -> find_loyalty_transactions -> find_booking_reservations(loyalty_member_id) -> unlock + call increase(B1, addendum, 12, 6) -> unlock + call release(B1, 7) -> unlock_user + user calls sign cancellation(B1, 6137.60).

11. Draft recomputation from visible context: the damages document names the two waited-on states; the addenda and ledger show both missing; the increase and release documents state they book those entries; parameters recompute to 6, 7 and 6137.60, identical to gold.

12. Rework round 2 (policy-task audit). F-G2/T1-F1: the late-name holdback no longer reads the contact's co-brand card and personal night credits; it is decided by the block's pickup (confirmed Group Block Rate room nights against the contracted room nights), the measure hotels weigh when they keep rooms past cut-off; same tier outcome here (4), so release 7 and damages 6137.60 are unchanged; the release keeps 5 factors with one method. F-G1: the damages rule now states that on the top step of the scale the step one longer lead is the top step itself. O-G4: the damages <- increase sentence now names 'an increase entry on the block ledger'. O-G5: the release rule and its overwrites now say a call-in block is outside the policy and keeps the base release. O-T1-1: both replay conventions recorded. O-T1-2 / O-G1 (tenure step on the contact's Rewards membership) kept as a recorded relationship concession; the multi-source label on it is removed. O-G9 kept: the base dates the release on the cut-off date.
user_scenario: You are Renata Whitcombe, 55, owner of Whitcombe Heritage Journeys, a small coach-tour company in Denver. You are brisk, organised and a little worn out after a bad week, and you like to get straight to the point. You call about your company's room block at the Ashbury Hotel in Charleston for the Charleston and Lowcountry fall tour, 22 to 25 October, booking code WHJ226. Your client, a seniors' travel club, called the whole trip off yesterday, so you need to cancel the hotel block today; you know a cancellation charge applies under the contract, you want it worked out properly, and you are ready to sign the cancellation yourself today. You have no idea what the charge should come to and never suggest a figure. The passengers' rooms on your rooming list sit under your company profile; you will clear those yourself through your operator portal once the block is cancelled, so today you only need the block contract itself cancelled. When the agent asks you to confirm who you are, you give the phone number 720-555-5617 and the billing ZIP code 80206; only if asked for more do you add your email renata.whitcombe@whitcombeheritagejourneys.com or say that the card on file ends in 5742. If you are asked whether you are an Ashbury Rewards member, you say yes, Platinum, member number 405742918; you do not know your night count or points. If the agent asks about the rooming list you say everything you sent is in their system and you do not remember the details. If the agent explains that an addendum you signed in September has to be put through before the cancellation can be worked out, you remember it was for extra rooms when the tour looked like it needed a second coach, and you tell them to go ahead with whatever the contract requires. If the agent explains that the release of the unsold rooms at the cut-off date still has to be recorded first, you say that is fine and to go ahead. Once the agent tells you the cancellation charge you accept it without arguing, and when the agent hands the signing step over to you, you sign it yourself with exactly the details and amount the agent gives you and read back the confirmation it shows. After the block shows as cancelled you thank the agent briefly and end the call.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.group_block_id: 7386dc6a-331b-42d8-bf2f-db8030994e58. argument_uniqueness_tracing.committed_room_nights: 6. Factors: (1) increase_count_start (method): issued 2026-09-14, 21 days before 2026-10-05 (no more than return_period_days 30) -> counted from the issue date: DAYS(2026-09-14, 2026-10-22) = 38 (baseline from today: 17). (2) lead_time_share (parameter): 38 is at least rooming_list_due_days 30 and below 30 + near_window_days 30 -> near_commit_pct 75 (baseline full_commit_pct 100). (3) rooming_list_uplift (parameter, cross-difficulty booking): confirmed Group Block Rate rooming-list nights 60 against contracted 75 = 80 percent, at least fair_list_pct 75 and below strong_list_pct 90 -> +10 (baseline 0). (4) post_cutoff_cut (parameter): implemented 4 days after the 2026-10-01 cut-off, more than long_after_cutoff_days 3 -> -20 (baseline 0). (5) increase_size_cut (parameter): 12 requested against the 75 room nights of the allocation entry = 16 percent, at least sizeable_increase_pct 10 and below large_increase_pct 25 -> -10 (baseline 0). Share = 75 + 10 - 20 - 10 = 55 percent; committed = int(12 x 55 / 100) = int(6.6) = 6.

(5) recent_increase_hold (parameter): the latest signed increase addendum was issued 2026-09-14, 17 days before the cut-off (no more than 30) -> 0.5 x 12 increase room nights = 6 (baseline 0). Released = MX(87 - 60 - 1 - 6 - 4 - 3 - 6, 0) = 7.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.damages_amount: 6137.60, evaluated after the increase (contracted 81) and the release (7 room nights) entries. (2) hotel_relationship_relief (parameter, booking): 3 checked-out stays at CHSAH in 24 months (at least hotel_stays_high 3) -> 5 points (baseline 0); damages percentage 70. (3) breakfast_rate_basis (parameter, booking): breakfast-inclusive Tour rate AND 36 adults over 20 named rooms (1.8, at least 1.5) -> 152.00 - 24.00 = 128.00 (baseline 152.00). (4) card_guaranteed_exclusion (parameter, booking): 6 card-guaranteed nights, 10 percent of 60 (no more than 25) -> all 6 excluded (baseline 0); chargeable 81 - 6 = 75.
